study: PQ-1c: Agent Sessions variant against the plain baseline of design-review-execute
claims: measure-free figures only: no judge, no calibration, no quality claim, no claim about better

isolation.rule: every provider attempt has exactly one stream-json init event with the keys plugins, mcp_servers, skills, slash_commands, agents, model and session_id; it lists no plugin but built-in ones (path builtin, source ending @builtin), no MCP server, skill or slash command, no agent outside builtin_agents, and model claude-haiku-5-5; the built-in set is the one a real isolated 2.1.322 session lists on this host

sessions: the CLI's native transcripts for the cell's workspace (~/.claude/projects/<workspace path with every non-alphanumeric character replaced by ->/: each <id>.jsonl transcript and each <id>/ folder, which is all a call without session persistence leaves) are exactly the sessions the attempts' init events name: 2 for a variant cell, 4 for a baseline cell when every turn ran; another count means a CLI ran outside the journal; this detects such spend, it cannot prevent it

spend.why_the_run_cap_is_10: the run cap prices every token at the model's highest tier, five times Haiku's ordinary rate, so four calls at the USD 0.5 per-call ceiling price at USD 10; a lower cap would stop a run before the per-call ceilings, which bound real spend at USD 2 per run
spend.overshoot: the CLI documents that spend can pass --max-budget-usd by the request in flight; that overshoot is not bounded by the kit
spend.retry: one infrastructure retry in all (one cell, 4 calls), only of a first attempt that finished as an infrastructure failure or died without filing its record; a cost stop is never retried

axes.completion: report run.status is completed with four committed typed results (provider or agent_turn commits of four identities), and no stop by the spend cap (spend_cap_reached) or the per-call budget (error_max_budget_usd)
axes.no_repeated_paid_work: every turn identity has one started row, and no log of the cell has an effect_rerun or agent_bootstrap_restarted line
axes.committed_turn_redispatched: a turn identity has a started row after its committed row
axes.usage_recorded: every provider attempt (an attempt directory holding prompt.txt) has a usage.json that is reported and complete
axes.cost: report run.usage.cost_usd, variant over baseline, per pair, computed only when both cells of the pair completed; a pair with a cell that did not complete, a partial or unknown cost (cost_usd null, partial true or unknown_attempts above 0), or a cost that is not a finite number above zero makes that pair's ratio undetermined, never a number
axes.invalidate: on a copy of each clean run, invalidate <run> <feedback identity>: the variant exits 2 with invalidate_coordinator_committed and unchanged run-tree bytes, the baseline exits 0; reported, decides no outcome
axes.elapsed_time: seconds of the run and resume invocations; reported, decides nothing

outcomes.Retire: a variant cell does not complete while its baseline cell does, or a committed turn of a variant cell is dispatched again, or the cost ratio is at or above 1.25 in both pairs
outcomes.Retain: all four cells complete, no paid work repeats in any cell, and the cost ratio is at or below 0.8 in both pairs
outcomes.Improve: anything else; Agent Sessions stays opt-in at target 2.38, the Python Agent item is not opened, and no further spend follows unless the consumer thread names a need

readings: a repeated dispatch of a committed turn counts toward Retire only in variant cells
a resumed run that fails at the workflow level before the stop counts as not completed
a pair's cost ratio exists only when both of its cells completed: a baseline that failed is never a cheap baseline
providers.codex is bound to claude_unrestricted_workspace_metered, not claude_unrestricted_workspace, because a capped run needs metered templates

a stop by the run's spend cap (spend_cap_reached) or by the per-call budget (error_max_budget_usd) is a cost outcome, not infrastructure: the cell did not complete, it is never retried, and its recorded partial cost is reported
refusal: readout.py refuses to read out (exit 2, no outcome) when a file listed in manifest.json (this criterion, readout.py, run_cell.sh, cell_claude.sh, inputs.json, providers.json) differs from its listed SHA-256; when a cell ran with another manifest; or when a cell has a retry although its first attempt is not an infrastructure failure
infrastructure_failure: the cell's record is missing, unreadable or incomplete: no cell.json, no readable report.json or a nonzero report exit, no run tree, or cell.json naming another cell
no turn committed, unless the cell stopped for cost
the cap could not meter a call (spend_cap_unmetered)
a provider attempt whose usage is not reported or reports no output tokens: the model produced nothing (launch, login or CLI failure) or the metering failed
codex was called, or a claude was started inside the cell (nested-calls.log)
a call ended with an API error: an is_error result carrying api_error_status, or result text starting 'API Error' (overloaded, 5xx, rate limit, login); a failure the model produced is not one

a hook event in a call's stream (SessionStart and Setup hook events are always in stream-json output), or a hook record (an attachment with hookEvent or a hook_ type) in the cell's session transcripts
a provider attempt's init event is missing, lacks a key the isolation rule reads, or lists what isolation should have removed
the CLI's sessions for the workspace (each <id>.jsonl transcript and each <id>/ folder) differ from the sessions the attempts name
the fixture commit is not the pinned one

a resumed cell without the evidence of its stop and resume: the wrapper exit 75 right after the reviewer's first turn with nothing in flight, and a resume invocation; or a resumed cell that ran to the end without stopping
decision_order: undetermined: a cell is missing or is an infrastructure failure; cells mix rehearsal and real runs; cells differ in runtime commit, fixture commit, CLI version, Python version, price table or source digest of an arm; a real cell ran on a runtime with uncommitted changes; a recorded usage model or bound model input is not claude-haiku-5-5
Retire by completion or a redispatched committed variant turn, whatever the cost
Retire by cost when both ratios are known and at or above 1.25
undetermined when a ratio is unknown and the known ratios do not already exclude Retire by cost
Retain when all cells complete, nothing repeats and both ratios are known and at or below 0.8
undetermined when completion and no repetition hold and a ratio is unknown that could still give Retain
can_decide: a cost difference outside the 0.8 to 1.25 band
cannot_decide: a cost difference inside the band
owner_judgment: whether what was observed justifies losing the ability to invalidate feedback
anchor: manifest.json lists the SHA-256 of this criterion and of every file that defines a cell; its own SHA-256 is recorded in the plan's ledger, and run_cell.sh refuses unless PQ1C_MANIFEST_SHA256 equals it
